grades.lower_bound_mechanism: minimal-support arithmetic descent (core ≤ a_1) + disjoint-witness pairing
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: membership periodic mod L = ∏U, T = count of admissible integers per length-L window
grades.notes: Complete rigorous proof. Scanning property plus the self-blocking identity 𝒢=ℱ gives the full characterization (8) for all x ≥ a_1. Finiteness of U is proved for all terms via descent on minimal supports to cores ≤ a_1 and a disjoint-witness bound. Periodicity mod L=∏U with window count T yields a_{n+T}=a_n+L for every n ≥ 1.
